raw_description:
We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to join our Core AI team. You will design, train, and deploy production-scale deep learning models for intelligent automation. 

Responsibilities:
- Build and fine-tune machine learning and deep learning pipelines using Python and PyTorch.
- Implement end-to-end feature engineering and model evaluation protocols with Scikit-Learn.
- Containerize models using Docker and orchestrate deployments in cloud environments.
- Collaborate with data engineers to optimize SQL data extraction and ingestion.
- Maintain clean version control using Git and participate in peer code reviews.

Required Qualifications:
- Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and core Machine Learning algorithms.
- Solid foundation in Feature Engineering, Model Evaluation, and SQL.
- Practical experience with Docker and Git version control.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with MLOps tools like MLflow, Kubernetes, and AWS.
- Familiarity with Large Language Models, LangChain, and FastAPI microservices.

Looking for a Data Scientist to transform complex business datasets into predictive insights. 

Responsibilities:
- Formulate business questions into statistical experiments and hypothesis testing.
- Perform exploratory data analysis using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
- Develop predictive models using Scikit-Learn and classical Machine Learning techniques.
- Write advanced SQL queries to aggregate and transform relational data.
- Create executive dashboards and communicate findings to stakeholders.

Requirements:
- Expertise in Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, and statistical hypothesis testing.
- Strong grasp of Machine Learning algorithms (regression, classification, clustering).
- Demonstrated experience with Data Visualization (Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Tableau).

Senior Data Engineer wanted to build high-throughput batch and streaming data architectures. 

Responsibilities:
- Architect distributed data processing pipelines using Apache Spark and PySpark.
- Design real-time streaming ingestion pipelines with Apache Kafka.
- Schedule and monitor DAGs using Apache Airflow.
- Model dimensional data warehouses in PostgreSQL and Snowflake.
- Implement resilient ETL / ELT workflows adhering to software engineering best practices.

Requirements:
- Fluent in Python and advanced SQL.
- Hands-on mastery of Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, and Apache Airflow.
- Deep understanding of Data Warehousing principles and ETL architecture.

We are hiring a passionate Frontend Developer to create intuitive user interfaces for our AI analytics platform. 

Responsibilities:
- Build reusable, accessible UI components with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- Manage complex client state using Redux Toolkit.
- Integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints seamlessly.
- Ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsive design on desktop and mobile.

Requirements:
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Modern styling experience with Tailwind CSS.
- State management with Redux.
- Version control with Git.

Seeking a talented Backend Developer to engineer scalable APIs and microservice architectures. 

Responsibilities:
- Develop asynchronous RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI.
- Design and optimize relational schemas in PostgreSQL and manage in-memory caching with Redis.
- Implement comprehensive unit testing with pytest and maintain high test coverage.
- Package applications in Docker containers and deploy via CI/CD pipelines.

Requirements:
- Proven experience with Python, FastAPI (or Django/Flask), and PostgreSQL.
- Proficiency with Redis, Docker, Git, and automated Unit Testing.
- Sound knowledge of RESTful API design principles.

Looking for a Cloud DevOps Engineer to maintain cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. 

Responsibilities:
- Manage multi-cluster Kubernetes environments on AWS (EKS).
- Provision Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
- Configure CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
- Implement observability, monitoring, and alerting with Prometheus and Grafana.
- Automate system administration tasks using Linux shell scripting and Python.

Requirements:
- In-depth Linux administration and command-line proficiency.
- Hands-on containerization experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Infrastructure as Code with Terraform on AWS or GCP.
- CI/CD and Git automation experience.

We are recruiting a Senior NLP Engineer to pioneer Generative AI and agentic systems. 

Responsibilities:
- Fine-tune open-source LLMs using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
- Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures with LangChain and Vector Databases (Pinecone/ChromaDB/FAISS).
- Preprocess, tokenize, and clean unstructured text corpora at scale.
- Deploy low-latency LLM inference endpoints using FastAPI.

Requirements:
- Deep mastery of Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models.
- Hands-on expertise with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, and Vector Databases.
- Strong Python programming and Git workflow.
